item.title: Version 1.2.26 (Build 20261111)
item.description:
What's New

feat(undo): add option to undo words whose mark was cancelled by a repeated key

In Telex a repeated mark key ("ff", "rr") cancels the mark and swallows

one key, so "traffic" shows as "trafic" and "current" as "curent". Undo

typing refused these words because canUndoTyping only accepted words

that still carry a diacritic, so the undo hotkey passed through.

Add an opt-in sub-option under "Hoàn tác gõ tiếng Việt" (default off).

When on, canUndoTyping also accepts a word whose raw keystroke count

differs from the characters on screen. The keystroke sequence already

keeps both repeated keys, so undoTyping restores "traffic" unchanged.

  • Thread undoTypingAfterMarkCancel through Preferences, SharedSettings,

EngineSettings, RuntimePreferences and KeyboardEventHandler

  • Show the setting in the General section and the debug summary
  • Bump MARKETINGVERSION to 1.2.26 and CURRENTPROJECT_VERSION to 20261111

Fixes #334
